abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The rise of Alzheimer's disease (AD) immunotherapies underscores the need for accessible, time-efficient biomarkers for early diagnosis. MRI-based deep learning shows promise in this regard, yet few models have undergone comprehensive clinical validation. Using the SILCODE cohort (722 Chinese participants, 1,105 scans), we test the transportability of our classifier (pretrained on Western samples) to an independent Chinese cohort without retraining. The associations between risk scores and disease progression, cognitive performance, and plasma biomarkers are examined. In addition, an interpretable framework is developed to generate individualized brain risk maps and identify subtypes. The model classifies AD with an AUC of 0.913 and 95.2% sensitivity, identifying 90.5% of high-risk individuals 2-3 years before clinical diagnosis. Risk scores correlate significantly with cognitive and plasma indices, particularly p-tau 217. Brain risk maps reveal AD subtypes, including a subgroup with rapid cognitive decline. These findings establish a population-robust, clinically relevant MRI-based model for early AD detection and risk stratification.

abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.

abstract: [Nature] Cancer cells show highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour1-5. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here we generated a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across many regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalizes tumours into distinct tissue microenvironments and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Consistently, using a new deep-learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ, we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue microenvironments. We validate this cellular trajectory by using somatic mutation-based hierarchies in vivo and an experimental patient-derived organoid model ex vivo. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalized myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.

abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.

abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.

abstract: [Genomics] Predicting patient response to cancer treatments remains a challenge due to tumor heterogeneity and complex tumor microenvironments (TMEs). Modern spatial genomics technologies enable gene expression profiling alongside histological frameworks, but comprehensive analysis and clinical translation of these high-dimensionality datasets will benefit from Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). This review synthesizes computational approaches that address challenges of spatial data by examining deep-learning architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for histological feature extraction and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for modeling cell-cell interactions. We then explore the paradigm of Foundation Models that bridge histopathology with transcriptomics to accelerate the identification of spatially resolved biomarkers, improve patient stratification for immunotherapy and targeted treatments, and advance the clinical translation of mechanistic insights derived from the tumor microenvironment.

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed several areas of ophthalmic practice, most notably diabetic retinopathy screening, where autonomous systems have achieved regulatory approval and real-world deployment. Uveitis, by contrast, remains at an earlier stage in translation. Its heterogeneity, longitudinal disease course and reliance on multimodal clinical reasoning present distinct challenges, compounded by small, fragmented and geographically restricted datasets. This review examines the landscape of AI applications in uveitis and maps them to the established ophthalmic AI validation pipeline, from algorithm development through to clinical deployment. Evidence varies between individual studies: selected vitritis detection and aetiological classification models have undergone independent external testing, while anterior chamber inflammation quantification includes small single-centre feasibility studies. Emerging applications, including recurrent-course prediction, treatment-response modelling, fluorescein angiography segmentation, natural language processing and foundation model fine-tuning, remain predominantly at proof-of-concept stages. Despite encouraging algorithmic performance, the studies discussed have not demonstrated clinical actionability: evidence that an AI output changes a clinical decision, leads to an appropriate management intervention and ultimately improves a patient-relevant outcome. We argue that the principal translational bottleneck is therefore not algorithmic capability alone, but the absence of harmonised longitudinal datasets, geographically diverse validation, prospective evaluation and, critically, studies linking AI output → clinical decision → management intervention → patient outcome. International collaborative registries offer a pathway towards addressing these gaps. The next phase of uveitis AI must move beyond model performance towards clinically actionable systems that improve diagnosis, disease monitoring, treatment selection and relapse prediction, ultimately delivering meaningful benefit to patients with ocular inflammatory disease.

abstract: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.

abstract: [Nature methods] De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
zh_abstract: 我们利用医学图像合成构建了一个具有挑战性的多模态评估框架，以揭示前沿模型的幻觉行为。由于现有医学数据集很少将不同图像模态（如X线片与外部临床照片）配对，评估多模态推理一直较为困难。为填补这一空白，我们提出Trick-or-Treat，一个对抗性多模态医学基准，将真实胸部X线片与合成临床照片配对，以挑战模型的跨模态推理能力。针对多种不同病症，我们各创建了两对图像，两对共用同一张胸部X线片，但配以不同的外部照片。在匹配对中，胸部X线片和照片均包含提示同一疾病的表现（例如，肺部阴影和水痘中可见的结痂皮损提示水痘肺炎）。在不匹配对中，照片描绘的是另一种不会导向同一统一诊断的临床表现（例如，将结痂皮损替换为普通痤疮）。合成照片的生成使得临床表现可以变化，而人物特征和拍摄环境保持一致，从而减少混杂。在对三个前沿模型的研究中，我们发现模型在45–57.5%的不匹配对中对照片的具有临床意义的表现产生幻觉，高于同一照片单独呈现时的25–37.5%。面对不匹配对时，模型倾向于忽略不匹配，转而幻想出与X线片更为吻合的表现（例如，将痤疮误读为结痂皮损，以支持水痘的诊断）。Trick-or-Treat既展示了前沿模型医学推理中令人担忧的错误模式，也为在对抗性多模态评估中使用合成图像提供了概念验证。

abstract: Retrieving an enzyme for a target reaction provides a starting point for evolution, but predicting how to improve it remains difficult. This requires connecting evolutionary information with the structural and chemical context of catalysis. Here we present AlphaEnzyme, an enzyme foundation model built on a structure-grounded representation of an enzyme paired with its reaction, from which catalytic compatibility, kinetics and mutational response are read out together. On a time-separated benchmark, AlphaEnzyme achieves a top-1 catalyst retrieval success rate of 30.1%, against 17.2% for the strongest baseline. Michaelis constant predictions achieve the highest rank correlations among the compared methods, reaching 0.64 for enzymes sharing at most 40% identity with the kinetic training set. The model also enriches high-fitness TrpB variants at a budget of 16 candidates without target-specific fitness training. In prospective transaminase engineering, several prioritized variants exceed the parent, with the best design yielding a 30.4-fold increase in product signal in a lysate-based assay while retaining (R)-selectivity. Together, AlphaEnzyme provides a common molecular basis for selecting starting enzymes and prioritizing sequence changes for their improvement.

abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] Hallucinations generated by large language models (LLMs) represent an emerging safety top event in radiology, where subtle interpretive errors can rapidly propagate into clinical decisions. Although these systems demonstrate remarkable linguistic fluency, their underlying probabilistic architecture is, in some cases, not aligned with the demands of diagnostic intelligence, factual reliability, or safety standards. This work presents a comprehensive review describing the pathways that lead to hallucinations in radiology domain generative LLMs, mapping the risks derived from model architecture, data quality, black-box opacity, and automation bias. It also identifies the preventive strategies required to control these risks, including legal and governance safeguards, rigorous data curation protocols, explainability and simulation frameworks, and structured human oversight. This review shows how hallucinations may distort diagnostic reasoning, generate fictitious clinical data, and precipitate erroneous management decisions with potential patient harm, underscoring the need for controlled deployment strategies before integrating generative AI into radiological workflows.

abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used in brain arteriovenous malformation (AVM) neuroimaging, but translation readiness remains incompletely mapped. To characterize AI-related applications, reported performance, and barriers to clinical deployment. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR-guided review of PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar from inception through 20 December 2025, with PubMed additionally searched on 23 August 2026. Eligible sources addressed AI, machine learning, radiomics, or automated computational analysis of brain AVM imaging. Results were charted descriptively; heterogeneous metrics were not pooled. Thirty-two sources were included: 28 primary reports and four contextual evidence syntheses. Thirteen primary reports had a documented AI/ML component. Of these, seven used imaging-derived inputs only, three combined imaging with clinical or treatment predictors, one compared separate imaging and clinical models, and two had unresolved final predictor sets. Three nidus-segmentation reports gave Dice estimates of 0.754, 0.80 and 0.82; partition details were unavailable for the first, and the last applied to detected lesions. Validation designs and clinical targets varied, precluding a pooled performance estimate. AI/ML shows technical feasibility in selected brain AVM imaging and prediction tasks. Clinical benefit and routine deployment have not been demonstrated. Multicenter institutional validation, calibration, transparent reporting and prospective clinical-impact evaluation remain priorities.

abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.
zh_abstract: 研究者将大语言模型（LLM）用作社会模拟中的智能体，通过向智能体提供观察信息和背景信息的提示来塑造其行为。然而，已有研究表明，LLM 智能体在保持含义不变的提示变化下，其行为会发生显著改变，这给社会模拟的验证带来了问题。一种看似合理的假设是，这种脆弱性反映了缺乏落地依据（grounding），可通过丰富提供给智能体的上下文来降低。更丰富的上下文是否能提高稳健性目前仍不清楚，部分原因在于上下文丰富度和稳健性很少以支持对照比较的方式加以定义。针对第一个需求，我们提出了受控上下文丰富化方法，这是一组提示替换规则，可系统性地丰富不同类型的上下文：中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据和规范性决策依据。针对第二个需求，我们提出将选择性稳健性作为一项验证标准：即对保持含义不变的提示变化不敏感，同时对社会世界中与决策相关的变化做出有方向性的响应。我们在一个类囚徒困境博弈中演示了该框架，展示了如何利用它来识别哪些形式的上下文丰富化能产生更理想且更稳健的智能体行为。我们发现，这些丰富化形式会产生不同的行为模式，且这些模式在所测试的两个模型之间存在差异。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Cardiovascular Health Behavior Change: A Narrative Review of Patient-Facing Tools.
source: PubMed · Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education

summary: 叙述性综述检索10个数据库，纳入19项研究，评价对应LE8框架的患者端AI工具的效果与公平性。
key_points: 纳入19项实证研究，其中5项为随机对照试验
聚焦心血管健康教育与行为改变
关注效果与公平性

abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death in the United States and disproportionately affects racial/ethnic minoritized populations, low-income communities, older adults, and rural residents. Behavioral interventions can reduce cardiovascular risk, yet traditional programs face scalability barriers, including high costs and limited reach. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on the efficacy and equity of patient-directed AI tools that support health education and behavior change for cardiovascular health. Using PRISMA-ScR elements, we searched 10 databases (January 2010 to December 2025), yielding 19 empirical studies evaluating Generation 2.0 AI systems aligned with the American Heart Association's Life's Essential 8 (LE8) framework. Of these, five were randomized controlled trials (RCTs), and 14 were nonrandomized (quasi-experimental, observational, or early-stage) studies. AI-enabled interventions such as conversational agents, machine-learning models, and reinforcement-learning systems addressed hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, and related conditions. Among the RCTs, one demonstrated superiority of an AI-powered program over usual care (AI-delivered Diabetes Prevention Program), whereas the remaining four reported outcomes equivalent or non-inferior to standard behavioral care. Effects were most apparent in high-intensity interventions that paired machine learning-based personalization with structured behavioral curricula, although the multi-component nature of these programs limits inference about AI-specific contributions. Across nonrandomized studies, greater engagement intensity was consistently associated with improved cardiometabolic outcomes, although causal attribution to AI-specific mechanisms remains limited. Most studies had small samples, short follow-up, and limited reporting on safety and equity. Technology-intensive interventions were concentrated in higher-resourced settings, and populations with limited health literacy showed reduced engagement. Overall, evidence supports cautious optimism that AI can meaningfully scale personalized cardiovascular prevention; however, realizing that equitable and clinically meaningful impact will require rigorous trials with longer follow-up, explicit behavioral science integration, safety-conscious governance, and equity-centered strategies addressing digital determinants of health.
zh_abstract: [Health education & behavior：公共卫生教育学会官方出版物] 心血管疾病（CVD）是美国的首要死因，对少数族裔、低收入社区、老年人和农村居民的影响尤为严重。行为干预可降低心血管风险，但传统项目面临可扩展性障碍，包括成本高和覆盖范围有限。本叙述性综述综合了关于面向患者的 AI 工具在支持心血管健康的健康教育和行为改变方面的有效性与公平性的证据。我们采用 PRISMA-ScR 的要素，检索了 10 个数据库（2010 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月），共纳入 19 项评估与美国心脏协会“生命基本8要素”（Life's Essential 8，LE8）框架相一致的第 2.0 代 AI 系统的实证研究。其中 5 项为随机对照试验（RCT），14 项为非随机研究（准实验、观察性或早期研究）。对话式智能体、机器学习模型和强化学习系统等 AI 赋能干预针对高血压、糖尿病、心力衰竭及相关疾病。在 RCT 中，1 项显示 AI 驱动的项目优于常规照护（AI 提供的糖尿病预防项目），其余 4 项报告的结局与标准行为照护相当或不劣于后者。效果在将基于机器学习的个性化与结构化行为课程相结合的高强度干预中最为明显，但这些项目的多组分性质限制了对 AI 特定贡献的推断。在非随机研究中，更高的参与强度始终与心脏代谢结局的改善相关，但将其因果归因于 AI 特定机制的证据仍然有限。大多数研究样本量小、随访时间短，且在安全性和公平性方面的报告有限。技术密集型干预集中在资源较充足的环境中，健康素养有限的人群参与度较低。总体而言，证据支持对 AI 能够有意义地扩大个性化心血管预防规模持谨慎乐观态度；然而，要实现这种公平且具有临床意义的影响，需要开展随访时间更长的严格试验、明确整合行为科学、实施注重安全的治理，并采取以公平为中心、应对健康数字决定因素的策略。

title: Contextual Semantic Pattern Recognition for Mental Health Monitoring Using ClinicalBERT Transformers.
zh_title: 基于ClinicalBERT的心理健康监测语义模式识别
summary: 将结构化心理健康记录转为文本描述后输入ClinicalBERT，并与RF、XGBoost、BERT、TabTransformer等对比。

abstract: [Brain and behavior] This study aimed to develop an interpretable ClinicalBERT-based framework for mental health monitoring using structured clinical data. Because the Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring dataset contains structured patient attributes rather than free-text clinical narratives, a structured-to-text transformation module was used to convert the records into contextual descriptions suitable for ClinicalBERT. The proposed model was compared with Random Forest, XGBoost, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), TabTransformer, and a Deep Neural Network, and to strengthen the experimental comparison, contemporary tabular transformer models, including SAINT and FT-Transformer, were also evaluated. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Cross-validation, confidence interval analysis, statistical significance testing, and ablation experiments were conducted to examine the reliability of the results. SHAP and LIME were used to explain global feature contributions and individual predictions. ClinicalBERT achieved an accuracy of 90.2%, a precision of 90.5%, a recall of 90.4%, and an F1-score of 90.6%, outperforming all comparison models. The additional validation analyses supported the stability of the results. SHAP and LIME further identified the patient attributes that contributed most strongly to the model's predictions. The findings indicate that structured clinical records can be transformed into contextual representations for transformer-based mental health monitoring. The framework combines predictive performance with interpretable output, although its evaluation is currently limited to a single dataset. Further validation using multi-institutional and prospective data is required.
zh_abstract: 【脑与行为】本研究旨在利用结构化临床数据，开发一种基于 ClinicalBERT 的可解释心理健康监测框架。由于“心理健康诊断与治疗监测”（Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring）数据集包含的是结构化的患者属性，而非自由文本的临床叙述，因此采用了结构化到文本的转换模块，将这些记录转换为适合 ClinicalBERT 的上下文描述。将所提出的模型与随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost、双向编码器表示（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers，BERT）、TabTransformer 和深度神经网络（Deep Neural Network）进行比较；为加强实验对比，还评估了当代表格型 Transformer 模型，包括 SAINT 和 FT-Transformer。采用准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数评估模型性能。通过交叉验证、置信区间分析、统计显著性检验和消融实验来检验结果的可靠性。使用 SHAP 和 LIME 解释全局特征贡献和个体预测。ClinicalBERT 的准确率为 90.2%，精确率为 90.5%，召回率为 90.4%，F1 分数为 90.6%，优于所有对比模型。额外的验证分析支持了结果的稳定性。SHAP 和 LIME 进一步识别出对模型预测贡献最大的患者属性。研究结果表明，结构化临床记录可以转换为上下文表示，用于基于 Transformer 的心理健康监测。该框架兼具预测性能与可解释的输出，但目前其评估仅限于单一数据集。尚需利用多机构和前瞻性数据进行进一步验证。

title: Wearable Arrhythmia Detection: Moving from your Watch to your Shirt?

abstract: [Current cardiology reports] Digital devices play an increasingly important role in the detection and screening of cardiac arrhythmias. Atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common arrhythmia, is associated with an increased risk of stroke, heart failure, and mortality. This review summarises the current evidence on wearable devices for screening and diagnosing atrial fibrillation. Numerous studies have demonstrated the value of wearables for AF detection and diagnosis. In addition, artificial intelligence enhances automated rhythm analysis and signal processing, supporting the increasing clinical implementation of digital technologies in outpatient care. Single-lead ECG devices provide the strongest evidence for AF detection, with smartwatches representing one of the most extensively investigated wearable technology. Limitations include motion artefacts and predominantly semi-continuous monitoring. Future research should focus on integrating artificial intelligence to improve signal analysis and artefact reduction, and on evaluating the impact of wearable-based strategies on clinically relevant outcomes, including stroke and heart failure.
zh_abstract: 【当前心脏病学报告】数字设备在心律失常的检测和筛查中发挥着越来越重要的作用。心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，与卒中、心力衰竭和死亡风险增加相关。本综述总结了关于可穿戴设备用于筛查和诊断心房颤动的现有证据。大量研究已证明可穿戴设备在 AF 检测和诊断中的价值。此外，人工智能增强了自动化节律分析和信号处理，支持数字技术在门诊医疗中日益广泛的临床应用。单导联心电图设备为 AF 检测提供了最有力的证据，其中智能手表是研究最为广泛的可穿戴技术之一。其局限性包括运动伪影以及监测主要为半连续性。未来研究应着重于整合人工智能以改进信号分析和减少伪影，并评估基于可穿戴设备的策略对包括卒中和心力衰竭在内的临床相关结局的影响。

title: Balancing innovation and ethics: responsible governance of artificial intelligence hallucinations in healthcare.
source: PubMed · Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM
zh_title: 平衡创新与伦理：医疗AI幻觉的负责任治理
summary: 论文基于生物医学伦理四原则，分析医疗生成式AI幻觉的伦理风险，并引入负责任研究与创新（RRI）框架提出治理思路。
key_points: 识别四条风险路径：知情同意、信任、健康损害、责任分配
使用生物医学伦理四原则分析

reason: 伦理治理类观点文章，常规增量档
abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare and may improve efficiency in clinical support, health management, and doctor-patient communication. Yet its tendency to hallucinate, that is, to generate medical information that appears plausible but is false, can create systemic ethical risks in high-risk medical settings. This paper addresses two questions: what distinctive ethical risks are created by medical AI hallucinations, and what governance mechanisms can respond to them? Using the four principles of biomedical ethics as an analytical tool, the paper identifies four risk pathways: weakened informed consent, erosion of doctor-patient trust, harm to life and health, and unfair responsibility allocation. It then introduces responsible research and innovation (RRI) to build a four-dimensional framework of anticipation, inclusion, reflexivity, and responsiveness. The main contribution of the paper is to integrate biomedical ethical principles with RRI governance tools in the specific context of medical AI hallucinations, developing a closed-loop governance matrix across technology development, clinical application, and regulatory oversight. This provides an operational pathway for moving medical AI from technical feasibility towards ethical trustworthiness.
zh_abstract: [医学中的哲学、伦理与人文 : PEHM] 生成式人工智能（AI）在医疗领域的应用日益增多，可能提高临床支持、健康管理及医患沟通的效率。然而，其产生幻觉的倾向，即生成看似合理但实为虚假的医学信息，可能在高风险医疗场景中造成系统性伦理风险。本文探讨两个问题：医疗AI幻觉会带来哪些独特的伦理风险，以及何种治理机制可以应对这些风险？本文以生物医学伦理四原则为分析工具，识别出四条风险路径：知情同意被削弱、医患信任受到侵蚀、对生命健康造成损害，以及责任分配不公。随后引入负责任研究与创新（RRI），构建包含预期、包容、反思和响应的四维框架。本文的主要贡献在于，在医疗AI幻觉这一特定情境下，将生物医学伦理原则与RRI治理工具相结合，形成贯穿技术开发、临床应用和监管监督的闭环治理矩阵。这为推动医疗AI从技术可行走向伦理可信提供了一条可操作的路径。

abstract: [The Australasian journal of dermatology] The smartphone has become dermatology's primary clinical camera, yet the photo it saves is assembled by software rather than being a faithful unedited photograph: several frames are merged, grain is removed, and texture is altered before the image file exists, so no unedited original survives. This processing is hidden, inconsistent between shots, recorded only in undocumented vendor-specific form, and cannot be fully disabled in the camera app. Smartphone photographs still serve to locate a lesion and support a referral, but the processing pipeline is ill-suited and potentially misleading for serial monitoring, research, and training of artificial intelligence models. We propose a per-image record of capture and processing, practical measures clinicians can take now, and smartphone camera processing pipelines built for clinical fidelity rather than aesthetic ends.
zh_abstract: [澳大拉西亚皮肤病学杂志] 智能手机已成为皮肤科主要的临床摄影设备，但其保存的照片是由软件合成的，而非忠实的、未经编辑的照片：在图像文件生成之前，已将多帧图像合并、去除噪点并改变纹理，因此不存在未经编辑的原始图像。这种处理是隐蔽的，各次拍摄之间不一致，仅以未公开记录的、厂商特定的形式记录，并且无法在相机应用中完全关闭。智能手机照片仍可用于定位病变和支持转诊，但其处理流程并不适合用于连续监测、研究以及人工智能模型的训练，并可能造成误导。我们提出了针对每张图像的拍摄与处理记录、临床医生目前即可采取的实用措施，以及以临床保真度而非美学目的为导向设计的智能手机相机处理流程。

title: Spatially and Compositionally Controlled Multimodal Glioblastoma MRI Synthesis with Latent Diffusion
zh_title: 潜在扩散模型实现空间与成分可控的胶质母细胞瘤多模态MRI合成
summary: 提出两阶段潜在扩散框架，先生成可控肿瘤分割图，再用ControlNet生成T1、T1Gd、T2、FLAIR图像。

abstract: Glioblastoma exhibits substantial heterogeneity in tumour morphology and composition across MRI modalities, often making available clinical datasets highly unbalanced in terms of patient pathologies. We propose a two-stage latent diffusion model (LDM) framework for the generation of explicitly controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans. First, a segmentation LDM generates tumour maps conditioned on location, spatial extent, axial position, and subregion composition. Second, a modality-conditioned LDM with ControlNet generates T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR images adhering to the requested segmentation. On a held-out test set, generated segmentations achieved a mean centroid error of 0.842 pixels and a subregion proportion error of 0.795 percentage points. ControlNet improved Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, reducing pooled FID from 42.59 to 36.12. An expert reader study yielded mean quality ratings of 6.60 for real images, 6.83 for ControlNet-generated images, and 6.77 for fully synthetic images.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤在不同 MRI 模态上的肿瘤形态和组成表现出显著异质性，常使现有临床数据集在患者病理方面高度不平衡。我们提出一种两阶段潜在扩散模型（LDM）框架，用于生成可明确控制的二维胶质母细胞瘤 MRI 扫描。第一阶段，分割 LDM 以位置、空间范围、轴向位置和亚区组成为条件生成肿瘤图。第二阶段，带有 ControlNet 的模态条件 LDM 生成符合所要求分割的 T1、T1Gd、T2 和 FLAIR 图像。在留出的测试集上，生成的分割结果平均质心误差为 0.842 像素，亚区比例误差为 0.795 个百分点。ControlNet 改善了所有四种模态的 Fréchet inception distance（FID），使合并 FID 从 42.59 降至 36.12。一项专家阅片研究得到的平均质量评分为：真实图像 6.60，ControlNet 生成图像 6.83，完全合成图像 6.77。

title: LungMend: A Healthy-Only Latent Diffusion Shape Prior for Lung Mask Correction in Severe Tuberculosis CT

abstract: Lung segmentation models such as R231 are widely used, but they fail on severe tuberculosis (TB) CT: cavities and consolidations look like non-lung tissue and are left out of the mask. We present LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects such masks using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion model, trained on healthy lungs with synthetically corrupted masks, learns to recover the complete lung from the faulty mask and the bone anatomy, without any pathological data or CT intensities. LungMend recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 misses and improves accuracy on expert-annotated slices. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend
zh_abstract: R231 等肺分割模型被广泛使用，但在重症结核病（TB）CT 上表现不佳：空洞和实变看起来像非肺组织，被排除在掩膜之外。我们提出 LungMend，这是一种仅利用健康解剖结构来纠正此类掩膜的后处理模型。一个潜在扩散模型在健康肺及经合成破坏的掩膜上训练，学习根据有缺陷的掩膜和骨骼解剖结构恢复完整的肺，无需任何病理数据或 CT 强度信息。LungMend 能恢复 R231 遗漏的空洞和实变，并提高专家标注切片上的准确性。代码：https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend

abstract: We tested whether direction-specific nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling (CRC) in the first trimester differed in pregnancies that later developed obstetric complications. The analysis included 2504 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort with valid level 3 home sleep recordings at 6-13 weeks' gestation. Bidirectional CRC between RR intervals and abdominal respiratory effort was quantified using bivariate phase-rectified signal averaging in consecutive 5-min segments. Coupling strength, local transition dynamics, and waveform irregularity were summarized by nightly mean and standard deviation. Associations with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM; n = 111), preeclampsia (n = 149), preterm birth (n = 192), and fetal macrosomia (n = 186) were examined using proportional-odds models with CRC feature quintile as the ordered outcome. Models included all four complications simultaneously and adjusted for maternal age, pre-pregnancy body mass index, race and ethnicity, gestational age at recording, relevant medical and family history, medication use, and apnea-hypopnea index >5 events/h. Holm correction was applied across outcomes. GDM was associated with lower respiration-to-heart rate coupling strength (cumulative odds ratio, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.31-0.64; P < 0.001) and shallower slope at the anchor point (0.63; 0.45-0.89; P = 0.03). Fetal macrosomia was associated with lower within-night variability in heart rate-to-respiration waveform irregularity (0.59; 0.45-0.77; P < 0.001). No associations with preeclampsia or preterm birth remained significant after correction. Direction-specific differences in nocturnal CRC were detectable in the first trimester in pregnancies that later developed GDM or resulted in fetal macrosomia.

abstract: Protein sequence databases are growing far faster than experimentally curated annotations, limiting functional interpretation of newly identified proteins and coding variants. We developed PALM, a protein annotation language model that jointly predicts domain and functional-site occurrence, while preserving overlapping and nested annotations through a soft-target objective. PALM integrates ESM2 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), learned layer aggregation, and a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) encoder. PALM was trained on ~15 million InterPro-annotated UniRef50 sequences spanning 17,951 domain and 1,383 site classes. Across 2.3 million held-out proteins, PALM achieved domain- and site-occurrence F1 scores of 0.941 and 0.877, respectively, and retained substantial performance in proteins with <20% sequence identity to the training and validation data. PALM also substantially outperformed ESM3 annotation baseline. Without training on variant-pathogenicity labels, PALM embedding disruption distinguished 151,823 ClinVar missense variants more accurately than ESM2 embedding disruption (AUROC 0.835 versus 0.710), and combining PALM embedding disruption with the ESM2 likelihood-ratio signal reached an AUROC of 0.877. The same combined zero-shot score outperformed AlphaMissense on a benchmark dataset on 128,161 missense variants, that were derived from literature but not present in ClinVar database. At the protein level, PALM embeddings showed stronger CATH-Gene3D superfamily organization than frozen ESM2 and ESM3 embeddings, and improved prediction of experimental activation and repression effects when combined with ESM2. In a downstream case study, we demonstrated the ability to use PALM-derived embedding as proxy of deep mutational scanning (DMS), showcasing the broad application of PALM. Together, PALM converts curated residue-level knowledge into transferable and mechanistically interpretable representations that connect protein sequence, function, and variant consequence.

abstract: Untargeted liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) metabolomics generates thousands of features, but incomplete metabolite annotation and reliance on predefined pathways limit their biological interpretation. Here we present FeatureMAP, an LC-MS feature-centric computational framework that integrates multi-evidence metabolite annotation, network-guided refinement, metabolic module discovery, and structured large language model-based functional interpretation. Across ten public datasets, FeatureMAP improved MS1-based metabolite candidate prioritization while reducing annotation redundancy. In semi-synthetic benchmarks, FeatureMAP recovered coordinated metabolic perturbations, achieving 92% recovery of a simulated perturbation, and distinguished concurrent metabolic processes. Controlled benchmarks further evaluated functional interpretation under competing metabolite-level signals. Based on FeatureMAP, we additionally developed PhenoMAP, a phenotype-aware knowledge graph comprising 12,929 dysregulated metabolic modules from 501 human metabolomics studies spanning 326 phenotypes. Module-level comparisons revealed reproducible metabolic similarities across independent studies and biologically supported relationships among phenotypes. Application to Alzheimer's disease cerebrospinal fluid and cellular datasets identified convergent membrane-lipid alterations and implicated galactose-linked glycosphingolipid remodeling. Together, FeatureMAP and PhenoMAP enable network-grounded interpretation of incompletely annotated LC-MS metabolomics data and systematic investigation of metabolic dysregulation across biological conditions.
zh_abstract: 非靶向液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）代谢组学可产生数千个特征，但代谢物注释不完整以及对预定义通路的依赖限制了其生物学解释。在此我们提出 FeatureMAP，一种以 LC-MS 特征为中心的计算框架，整合了多证据代谢物注释、网络引导的优化、代谢模块发现以及基于大语言模型的结构化功能解释。在十个公共数据集中，FeatureMAP 改善了基于 MS1 的代谢物候选优先排序，同时减少了注释冗余。在半合成基准测试中，FeatureMAP 恢复了协同的代谢扰动，对模拟扰动的恢复率达 92%，并能区分同时发生的代谢过程。受控基准测试进一步评估了在相互竞争的代谢物水平信号下的功能解释。在 FeatureMAP 的基础上，我们还开发了 PhenoMAP，这是一个表型感知知识图谱，包含来自 501 项人类代谢组学研究、涵盖 326 种表型的 12,929 个失调代谢模块。模块水平的比较揭示了独立研究之间可重复的代谢相似性，以及表型之间有生物学依据支持的关系。将其应用于阿尔茨海默病脑脊液和细胞数据集，发现了趋同的膜脂改变，并提示与半乳糖相关的糖鞘脂重塑有关。总之，FeatureMAP 和 PhenoMAP 能够对注释不完整的 LC-MS 代谢组学数据进行基于网络的解释，并可系统研究不同生物学条件下的代谢失调。

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Millions of people now use general-purpose large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet how these models respond to emotional disclosures and whether their responses functionally resemble established therapeutic practices remain uncharacterized. This study aimed to characterize how frontier LLMs respond to emotionally charged messages and examine whether their response patterns resemble therapeutic practices associated with self-awareness. We generated 54 simulated user inputs representing mild-to-moderate everyday emotional difficulties. These simulated user inputs were generated using 3 LLMs (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 2.5 Pro). The simulated user inputs systematically varied across 3 lengths and 5 communicative registers, ranging from raw venting to pragmatic requests. Then, each simulated user input was presented as a standalone user turn to the same 3 frontier LLMs, yielding 162 responses. Two independent clinical coders qualitatively coded the resulting responses using an inductive approach. The codes were compared and consolidated through iterative consensus, which yielded 8 higher-order categories. Acknowledging and validating segments appeared in 89.5% (145/162) of responses, emotion-focused suggestions in 84.6% (137/162), and interpretation in 67.3% (109/162). These patterns converged on emotional self-awareness, a construct associated with adaptive emotion regulation, suggesting that LLMs may repeatedly enact a recognizable micro-process of validation, affect labeling, interpretation, reflection, and regulation support. Models differed in stance, with some assigning emotional labels and interpretations directly rather than prompting users' own reflection. Frontier LLMs respond to emotional disclosures in patterned, largely convergent ways that approximate therapeutic techniques for building emotional awareness, though delivered more didactically than in clinical practice. Whether these responses build genuine self-awareness, reduce symptoms, or provide therapeutic benefit requires controlled and naturalistic investigation.
zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 目前已有数百万人使用通用大语言模型（LLM）获取心理健康支持，但这些模型如何回应情绪披露，以及其回应在功能上是否类似于既有的治疗实践，仍未得到刻画。本研究旨在描述前沿LLM如何回应带有强烈情绪的信息，并考察其回应模式是否类似于与自我觉察相关的治疗实践。我们生成了54条模拟用户输入，代表轻至中度的日常情绪困扰。这些模拟用户输入由3个LLM（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 2.5 Pro）生成，并在3种长度和5种沟通语域（从原始倾诉到务实请求）之间系统性变化。随后，将每条模拟用户输入作为独立的用户回合提交给相同的3个前沿LLM，共得到162条回应。两名独立的临床编码员采用归纳法对所得回应进行定性编码。通过反复协商达成共识，对编码进行比较和整合，形成8个高阶类别。承认与认可类片段出现在89.5%（145/162）的回应中，以情绪为中心的建议出现在84.6%（137/162）的回应中，解释出现在67.3%（109/162）的回应中。这些模式趋向于情绪自我觉察——一种与适应性情绪调节相关的构念，提示LLM可能反复演绎一种可识别的微过程，即认可、情感标注、解释、反思和调节支持。各模型在立场上存在差异，部分模型直接给出情绪标签和解释，而非引导用户自行反思。前沿LLM以模式化且基本趋同的方式回应情绪披露，近似于培养情绪觉察的治疗技术，但其呈现方式比临床实践中更具说教性。这些回应是否能建立真正的自我觉察、减轻症状或带来治疗获益，需要对照研究和自然情境研究加以检验。

abstract: [Small methods] Prolonged screen use has fostered cervical musculoskeletal disorders, indicating the need for non-invasive, comfortable, low-power posture monitoring system. In this work, we developed a sustainable self-powered triboelectric nanogenerator consisting a biodegradable guar gum-based biopolymer for energy harvesting and neck posture monitoring. The device employing a bilayer architecture, comprises a guar gum-bentonite triboelectric film coated with a guar gum-graphite conductive electrode, eliminating the need for a metallic electrode. The addition of Na-bentonite filler improves the dielectric and surface charge properties, producing a stable electrical output. As a flexible patch, the G-TENG measures unique biomechanical voltage signals representing neck flexion and slouching posture. The analysis of these electrical signals with machine learning algorithms enables the precise classification of neck angle and sitting postures. This current study presents a strategy for green, self-powered electronics that bridge personalized digital healthcare with sustainable biopolymers to mitigate global e-waste.

abstract: [Health policy (Amsterdam, Netherlands)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in health care to improve the quality of care, support clinical decision-making, and increase efficiency. As AI systems are integrated into healthcare workflows, they can also become involved in how work is managed, including directing tasks, coordinating workflows, monitoring activity, and evaluating performance. These managerial uses of digital and AI systems are commonly referred to as forms of algorithmic management. Such uses may contribute to the intended benefits of AI, but may also make work more standardised, measurable, and monitorable, potentially increasing managerial control, reducing professional autonomy, or intensifying work. Whether these consequences arise depends on how these systems are implemented and governed. Realising AI's potential in health care therefore requires explicit choices about how AI is used within healthcare organisations and how gains from automation are allocated, so that benefits for care are maximised while potential harms are limited.

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundMedical image segmentation is a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning, and its research landscape has expanded rapidly with the advancement of artificial intelligence. A systematic bibliometric overview of this field is therefore needed to clarify its intellectual structure and emerging trends.ObjectiveTo provide a comprehensive bibliometric overview of the global research landscape, developmental trends, collaboration networks, and emerging hotspots in the field of medical image segmentation over the past decade.MethodsA bibliometric analysis was performed on 21,437 publications related to medical image segmentation, indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection from 2016 to 2025. The analysis systematically examined publication outputs, country-level contributions, author collaboration networks, journal distributions, and keyword co-occurrence patterns.ResultsThe annual publication count increased remarkably from 25 in 2016 to 5,207 in 2025. China contributed the largest share with 11,556 publications, followed by the United States (3,272) and India (1,924). Core researchers formed stable intra-team collaborations, though inter-team cooperation remained limited. Keyword and citation analyses identified deep learning, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformers, U-Net, and their variants as dominant methodological themes. Case studies on skin and lung segmentation revealed differential research attention and international collaboration patterns across anatomical targets. A historical trajectory analysis showed methodological evolution from traditional image processing to fully convolutional networks and U-Net, and subsequently to hybrid architectures integrating attention mechanisms and Transformers.ConclusionMedical image segmentation has experienced substantial growth, driven by deep learning innovations. Future research may increasingly focus on multimodal foundation models capable of generalizable segmentation across diverse clinical scenarios. This bibliometric review offers researchers a valuable reference for understanding the intellectual structure and frontiers of the field.

abstract: [JACC. Case reports] Implantable loop recorders (ILRs) are often implanted to investigate unexplained syncopal episodes. However, ILRs may produce false alerts due to undersensing or artifacts, thus requiring careful review of numerous device recordings, which makes it challenging to identify clinically significant events. We report a case of a 77-year-old woman with recurrent syncopal episodes, in whom a 7-second pause was detected by an ILR. Device interrogations showed multiple pause alerts that were identified as false events because of poor R sensing. However, the artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced remote monitoring identified a true pause with blocked P waves, leading the patient to receive a pacemaker implantation. This case highlights the clinical value of AI-assisted remote monitoring in identifying clinically relevant arrhythmias among numerous device alerts. Improved automated filtering of ILR data may reduce diagnostic delays and help clinicians prioritize clinically significant events. ILRs may generate numerous false alerts because of sensing abnormalities, complicating the identification of clinically relevant events in routine practice. AI-enhanced remote monitoring may improve diagnostic efficiency by identifying true arrhythmic events within large volumes of device-generated data and guiding timely management.

abstract: Objective: To develop the Cardiologist Annotation Tool (CAT) for frame-level cardiac view and image-quality annotation in fetal echocardiography and compare it with spreadsheet-based annotation. Methods: CAT provides cine playback, frame navigation, and keyboard-based labeling without manual frame-range entry. Experts annotated 25 studies using both methods, and spreadsheet annotations were audited for predefined data-entry errors. In a randomized crossover study, six medical students annotated two normal studies, one with each method, against an expert reference. Results: Among 1,746 spreadsheet-annotated files, 6.2% contained major or critical data-entry errors, more frequently in congenital heart disease than normal studies (10.9% vs 3.4%). CAT yielded more annotated view segments per clip (3.6 vs 1.5). Rates of labeled and correctly labeled frames per minute were 1.77 and 1.68 times those with spreadsheets, respectively (both P = 0.031), with gains in all six students. No detectable difference in view-label accuracy was observed. Conclusion: CAT eliminates manual frame-range entry and enables finer-grained, structured annotation of fetal echocardiography, providing a practical approach to preparing datasets for AI research.

abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）扩展源成像旨在定位活跃的皮层区域并刻画其空间范围，然而有监督的逆问题网络通常依赖合成的 EEG-源配对数据，可能对合成数据与真实数据之间的不匹配较为敏感。我们提出一种物理信息引导的自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架，用于空间源重建，无需配对的源标签，也无需基于仿真的有监督预训练。导联场矩阵编码了从源到传感器的容积传导模型，并通过预测 EEG 与实测 EEG 之间的一致性来约束 INR。皮层电流密度被建模为以坐标为条件的连续场。经典逆估计提供热启动初始化和对源活动的空间约束，同时通过分块积分投影将该场映射为离散的源系数以用于正向建模。在不同噪声水平、源数量和源范围的仿真中，该方法在识别活跃皮层区域方面显示出最明显的优势，尤其是对于多个源和较大范围的源。使用癫痫患者的真实 EEG 记录和颅内刺激实验进行的定量与定性评估，进一步支持了该框架用于源成像的可行性。这些结果提示，物理信息引导的自监督 INR 在扩展源成像方面具有潜力。

abstract: [Bioethics] In this paper, we argue for the adoption of algorithmic bioethics, which uses algorithms, in the form of decision trees, to articulate, understand, apply, and evaluate bioethical arguments. Algorithms bring many benefits to the study of bioethics: they clearly, precisely, and transparently articulate the decision procedure and facts relevant to an ethical decision; furthermore, they can be used to systematically discover, map out, and compare different ethical decision procedures concerning a practical issue. We then also outline and tackle potential limitations of algorithmic bioethics, and explore future directions for using decision trees in bioethics. Throughout, we illustrate our points using a case study of ethical decision trees, created with the help of large language models, about conscientious objection in medicine.

abstract: [Journal of computational chemistry] A hybrid LSTM-Transformer Variational Autoencoder (LTVAE) framework is introduced in this paper for learning compact and chemically meaningful latent representations from SMILES strings, providing a SMILES-to-latent-to-SMILES representation model trained on ZINC15 and evaluated on ZINC15 and an out-of-distribution dye dataset. In the proposed model, sequential and structural dependencies in molecular strings are encoded using a bidirectional LSTM, while a Transformer-based decoder is employed to reconstruct valid molecular structures in the evaluated settings. When trained on a curated ZINC15 dataset, the framework achieves reasonable reconstruction performance, with 98.58% token-level accuracy, 92.19% string-level accuracy, a 99.30% chemical validity ratio, and an average Levenshtein distance of 0.29 using a 64-dimensional latent space. Reconstruction under an out-of-distribution evaluation setting is evaluated on a structurally distinct dye dataset, where 95.56% token-level accuracy and 85.30% validity are achieved. The learned latent space preserves trends aligned with both general molecular descriptors and dye-relevant structural descriptors, particularly conjugation length and aromatic surface fraction, with Fsp 3 providing complementary information on molecular saturation. Controlled perturbations in the latent space suggest smooth and chemically consistent structural variations, illustrating the continuity and interpretability of the learned latent manifold.
zh_abstract: [Journal of computational chemistry] 本文提出一种混合 LSTM-Transformer 变分自编码器（LTVAE）框架，用于从 SMILES 字符串中学习紧凑且具有化学意义的潜在表示，构建了“SMILES→潜在空间→SMILES”的表示模型，在 ZINC15 上训练，并在 ZINC15 及一个分布外染料数据集上进行评估。在所提出的模型中，使用双向 LSTM 对分子字符串中的序列依赖和结构依赖进行编码，同时采用基于 Transformer 的解码器，在所评估的设置中重建有效的分子结构。在经整理的 ZINC15 数据集上训练时，该框架在 64 维潜在空间下取得了较为合理的重建性能：词元（token）级准确率为 98.58%，字符串级准确率为 92.19%，化学有效率为 99.30%，平均 Levenshtein 距离为 0.29。在分布外评估设置下，于结构上差异明显的染料数据集上评估重建性能，词元级准确率为 95.56%，有效率为 85.30%。所学习到的潜在空间保留了与通用分子描述符和染料相关结构描述符均一致的变化趋势，尤其是共轭长度和芳香表面积分数，而 Fsp 3 则为分子饱和度提供了补充信息。对潜在空间进行的受控扰动提示，结构变化平滑且在化学上具有一致性，体现了所学潜在流形的连续性和可解释性。

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 医疗人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍较为零散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗 AI 的经典和新兴数学基础，并考察了主要的方法学和应用趋势。遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，通过系统检索 Scopus、Google Scholar 和 PubMed/MEDLINE 识别 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月 30 日发表的研究，适用时使用 Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 进行检索。使用 VOSviewer 进行文献计量分析，并采用改编的基于 JBI 的框架评估方法学质量，系统综述则采用 AMSTAR-2。在识别出的 653 条记录中，147 项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码显示，线性代数见于 100/147 项研究（68.0%），微积分与优化见于 91/147（61.9%），概率与统计见于 79/147（53.7%），突出了它们在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。另一项对主导方法学主题的互斥分类显示，可解释和可信 AI 见于 24/147 项研究（16.3%），统计与学习理论 23/147（15.6%），概率与贝叶斯方法 23/147（15.6%），微积分与优化 19/147（12.9%），线性代数 15/147（10.2%）。放射学和医学影像是主要的医疗应用领域（24.3%），而分类和诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗 AI 由一个相互关联的数学生态系统所支撑。包括图神经网络、Transformer 和量子机器学习在内的新兴方法，需要更强的外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，才能实现可靠的临床转化。

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] The rapid emergence of antimicrobial resistance has created an urgent need for diagnostic technologies capable of rapidly identifying resistant phenotypes and informing precision antimicrobial therapy. Conventional antimicrobial susceptibility testing methods remain clinically reliable; however, they are limited by relatively long turnaround times and restricted physiological resolution. In recent years, vibrational spectroscopy techniques have emerged as promising platforms for rapid phenotypic microbiology because they generate label-free biochemical fingerprints associated with proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and membrane biomolecules. When integrated with machine learning and artificial intelligence, these technologies could provide highly sensitive tools for rapid bacterial classification, resistance prediction, and monitoring of dynamic physiological adaptation during antibiotic exposure. This review discusses the integration of chemometrics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms with spectroscopic datasets, emphasizing both predictive performance and biological interpretability. It is highly useful for bacterial identification, biochemical characterization, and resistance profiling across multiple microbial species. Major controversies regarding genotype-versus-phenotype diagnostics, reproducibility, standardization, and AI explainability are also examined. Finally, we highlight current research gaps and future directions, including single-cell spectroscopy, multimodal phenotyping, explainable AI frameworks, and approaches in systems microbiology. Taken together, the available evidence indicates that integrating vibrational spectroscopy with artificial intelligence could substantially reshape future antimicrobial resistance diagnostics and mechanistic microbiology.

abstract: [Healthcare management forum] Telehealth is increasingly supported by connected devices, remote monitoring, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and distributed computing. These tools can extend access and support more responsive care, but their computational and environmental demands are rarely considered alongside clinical and organizational needs. We describe the current Canadian telehealth landscape, including remote care management, virtual visits, patient portals, and remote monitoring, and identify opportunities and gaps for AI integration. We then define Green AI in healthcare and explain how an IoT-fog-cloud architecture can support resource-aware telehealth. For health leaders, Green AI is not only an engineering issue. It affects procurement, infrastructure planning, workforce capacity, clinical workflow, environmental responsibility, and equity. Evaluation should consider clinical performance, resource use, organizational fit, and sustainability. Responsible AI-enabled telehealth requires more than technical performance. A Green AI perspective can help health organizations improve computational efficiency while maintaining patient safety, usable workflows, resilience, and equitable access.

abstract: Accurate target volume (TV) segmentation is essential for radiotherapy (RT) planning but remains time-consuming. Moreover, the final contour depends on the expertise of the radiation oncologist. Although deep learning has improved medical image segmentation, image-only models cannot encode the clinical reasoning that governs TV delineation, particularly for the clinical target volume (CTV), where boundaries are defined by clinical knowledge rather than imaging features alone. Prompt-driven segmentation has recently emerged as a strategy to address this limitation. This work aims to review these approaches for RT TV segmentation with four objectives: (1) compare the different prompting techniques used; (2) compare their performance against image-only baselines; (3) assess how they are evaluated against standard metrics, including the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), 95th Hausdorff distance, sensitivity, precision, and clinical assessment; and (4) identify the gaps needed for clinical translation. We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and arXiv for studies incorporating geometric, clinical text, or interactive prompts into deep learning models for RT TV delineation. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning head and neck, breast, prostate, lung, cervix, and rectal cancers. Seven studies used clinical text prompting, four used geometric prompting, and two used interactive prompting; three combined modalities. Reported DSC ranged from 0.67 to 0.93, compared to 0.65 to 0.91 for image-only baselines. None reported sensitivity or precision. Clinical text prompting appears well suited to CTV delineation. Evidence remains limited, and standardized prompt engineering and clinical validation are needed before these approaches can be translated into routine RT practice.

abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Legal epidemiology is a growing field wherein researchers examine the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Policy surveillance is a key part of the legal epidemiology process and leads to the creation of a legal dataset for econometric analyses. Policy surveillance includes conceptualizing the research scope, collecting legal data, and coding data to answer legal questions. Historically, policy surveillance has been slow and time-consuming, limiting timely information about the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Researchers are exploring the role of artificial intelligence using large language models (LLMs) to increase the efficiency and quality of the policy surveillance process. In this commentary, we describe potential uses of LLMs by researchers conducting policy surveillance as well as potential challenges that will need to be addressed before LLMs are widely used in the process. We also suggest areas for future research while emphasizing the need for development of guidelines for LLM use in policy surveillance.

abstract: Predicting the progression of COVID-19 in hospitalised patients was an important challenge during the pandemic, particularly when healthcare resources were limited. This study investigates the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to predict three clinical outcomes: death, admission to the intensive care unit (ICU), and clinical status (improvement or worsening). The study uses two patient datasets: an Algerian cohort of 80 patients from the Internal Medicine Department of the University Hospital Centre of Constantine, collected between July and August 2020, and a French cohort of 99 patients collected between March and May 2020. Five ML classifiers were evaluated: logistic regression (LR), k-nearest neighbours (KNN), classification and regression trees (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and support vector machines (SVM). Their performance was examined in combination with three feature-selection methods: analysis of variance (ANOVA), mutual information (MI), and recursive feature elimination (RFE). The results were also compared with multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using one to five hidden layers. Model evaluation included 30 repetitions of five-fold cross-validation on the training data, followed by evaluation on a separate hold-out test set. The results showed that selecting 20 features generally provided better cross-validated accuracy than selecting 30 features or using the full feature set. The best-performing classifier-feature-selection combination varied across the six dataset-outcome tasks. LR combined with RFE was selected for three tasks, LR combined with ANOVA for one task, and CART combined with ANOVA for two tasks. The selected ML models achieved test-set accuracies ranging from 0.47 to 0.95 and higher accuracy than the average MLP results in five of the six tasks. These findings suggest that ML methods can be useful for exploring clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients. However, the small sample sizes and limitations of the available data mean that the results should be interpreted with caution. Further evaluation using larger and independent patient datasets is needed before these models can be considered for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 预测住院COVID-19患者的病情进展是大流行期间的一项重要挑战，在医疗资源有限时尤为如此。本研究探讨利用机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型预测三种临床结局：死亡、入住重症监护病房（ICU）以及临床状态（改善或恶化）。研究使用两个患者数据集：一个是阿尔及利亚队列，包含2020年7月至8月间在君士坦丁大学医院中心内科收集的80例患者；另一个是法国队列，包含2020年3月至5月间收集的99例患者。研究评估了五种ML分类器：逻辑回归（LR）、k近邻（KNN）、分类与回归树（CART）、朴素贝叶斯（NB）和支持向量机（SVM）。并结合三种特征选择方法考察其性能：方差分析（ANOVA）、互信息（MI）和递归特征消除（RFE）。结果还与采用一至五个隐藏层的多层感知机（MLP）模型进行了比较。模型评估包括在训练数据上进行30次重复的五折交叉验证，随后在独立的留出测试集上进行评估。结果显示，选择20个特征通常比选择30个特征或使用全部特征获得更好的交叉验证准确率。在六个数据集—结局任务中，表现最佳的分类器—特征选择组合各不相同：三个任务选用LR结合RFE，一个任务选用LR结合ANOVA，两个任务选用CART结合ANOVA。所选ML模型在测试集上的准确率为0.47至0.95，且在六个任务中的五个任务中准确率高于MLP的平均结果。这些发现提示，ML方法可用于探索住院COVID-19患者的临床结局。然而，样本量小以及可用数据的局限性意味着对结果的解读应持谨慎态度。在这些模型可考虑用于临床之前，需要使用更大规模的独立患者数据集进行进一步评估。
